lines.text: I cut two hundred cables. Why wouldn't the last one *break?*
lines.style: Young man, fast and breathless, no pauses, scared, the question shot out sharp.

lines.text: Snip after snip, the elevators dropped. And with every one, she *clapped.*
lines.style: Young man, quick and tense, horrified, the last word disgusted.

lines.text: But the last one, my cable, the shears just *bounced* off.
lines.style: Young man, confused and scared, fast, the stressed word sharp.

lines.text: So I followed it down. It never went into the *floor.*
lines.style: Young man, whisper, slow and careful, dread rising on the last word.

lines.text: It wasn't tied to an elevator. It was tied to *me.*
lines.style: Young man, shocked realisation, quiet then broken, the last word heavy.

lines.text: Climb the cable... or jump down the *shaft?*
lines.style: Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.
Young man, urgent and direct, straight to the viewer, short.

music.title: Floor 0 - Tied
music.style: Horror thriller score. Starts instantly on a sharp metallic stinger, rapid snapping steel cables in a rhythm, falling whooshes and distant crashes, a cold detuned music box with slow creepy clapping feel, then a sudden hollow silence, a single taut cable humming, a slow rising dread swell, racing heartbeat and ticking to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
